mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_customer_promotion_code SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE xsy_customer_promotion_code SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_customer_promotion_code (customer_id, code, created_by) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{code}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: c.id, c.customer_id AS customerId, u.name AS customerName, c.code, u.seller_id AS sellerId, e.actual_name AS sellerName, c.revoked_at AS revokedAt, c.created_by AS createdBy, c.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT count(*) FROM xsy_customer_promotion_scan s WHERE s.code_id = c.id) AS scanCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xsy_customer_promotion_code c LEFT JOIN xsy_customer u ON u.id = c.customer_id AND u.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = u.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE c.code = #{code}

SELECT FROM xsy_customer_promotion_code c LEFT JOIN xsy_customer u ON u.id = c.customer_id AND u.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = u.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM xsy_customer_promotion_code c LEFT JOIN xsy_customer u ON u.id = c.customer_id AND u.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = u.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_customer_promotion_scan (code_id, customer_id, seller_id, client_ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{codeId}, #{customerId}, #{sellerId}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.scanned_at AS scannedAt, s.seller_id AS sellerId, e.actual_name AS sellerName, s.client_ip AS clientIp, s.user_agent AS userAgent FROM xsy_customer_promotion_scan s LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = s.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE s.code_id = #{codeId} ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.scanned_at AS scannedAt, s.seller_id AS sellerId, e.actual_name AS sellerName, s.client_ip AS clientIp, s.user_agent AS userAgent FROM xsy_customer_promotion_scan s LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = s.seller_id AND e.deleted_flag = FALSE WHERE s.seller_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1
